build_pointnet2_cuda_extension: build the pointnet2 CUDA extension by running python setup.py build_ext in the pointnet2 directory
install_pointnet2_extension: install the pointnet2 CUDA extension in editable mode using pip install -e in the pointnet2 directory
review_setup_py_cuda_config: review the setup.py CUDAExtension configuration for compile flags and source file discovery
refactor_setup_py_include_paths: refactor the setup.py to use a different include directory path for the pointnet2 extension headers
summarize_setup_py_ext_sources: summarize the setup.py to list all discovered C++ and CUDA source files for the pointnet2 extension
